purpose: Repair C2A reference-support coverage by changing only the spatial support geometry while preserving the strict reference-star filters, minimum reference count, morphology metrics, and external-label firewall.

diagnostic_motivation.rule: These values motivate spatial-support repair only; they do not authorize outcome-guided morphology thresholds or external-label joins.

reference_star_contract.normalization_formula: median + 1.4826*MAD; z=(target-median)/robust_sigma; robust_sigma must be finite and >0

spatial_support_repair.plate_grid: frozen 7x7 tile grid reconstructed from exact named plate header and pinned upstream tile-id logic
spatial_support_repair.unique_reference_assignment: assign each strict reference star to exactly one nearest plate-grid cell in full-plate pixel coordinates; ties resolved by lexicographic tile_id
spatial_support_repair.stop_rule: use the first ring with at least 20 unique strict reference stars; never continue to a larger ring once admitted
spatial_support_repair.failure_rule: if ring 3 has fewer than 20 unique strict references or robust sigma is nonpositive for any primary feature, target remains normalization-ineligible

engineering_holdout.plate_overlap_with_C2A: allowed but recorded; tile overlap forbidden
engineering_holdout.selection_rule: within each cluster after exclusions: typical = smallest |anomaly_score - full-cluster median| with src_id tie-break; unusual = largest anomaly_score with src_id tie-break; roles are disjoint
engineering_holdout.on_insufficient_pool: FAIL_CLOSED; do not relax tile-disjointness after seeing availability

inference_boundary.if_engineering_PASS_next_step: freeze C2B2 >=512-source holdout disjoint from both C2A and C2B1 before any morphology association inference
inference_boundary.if_engineering_FAIL_next_step: preserve negative certificate and localize failure; no threshold relaxation on C2B1
